analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 4 sessions. RSI has fallen from 63.6 to 50.6, remaining in neutral territory, while the MACD histogram has worsened from 3.7979 to -5.2935, indicating a continued downtrend. Volume ratio is 1.01, showing normal activity. The current price ($1,860.61) is consolidating around the Bollinger Band middle line ($1,882.47) and is below the SMA5 ($1,899.41) and EMA10 ($1,893.34), facing short-term bearish pressure. Weekly RSI (41.4) and weekly MACD histogram (36.2712) remain in bearish territory, making it prudent to wait for clear bullish signals on the daily chart before considering a position.
